panelDescription: Track how your keywords rank in Google.
removeConfirmDescription: This removes {{phrase}} from your tracked keywords. This can be undone by adding it back.

checkErroredReason.vendor_timeout: The search data did not arrive in time. This usually clears on the next check.
checkErroredReason.vendor_unavailable: The search data was temporarily unavailable. This usually clears on the next check.
checkErroredReason.vendor_malformed: The search data could not be read.
checkErroredReason.vendor_error: The check failed for an unrecorded reason.

emptyDescription: Track your first keyword to see how it ranks over time.
addDescription: Add one or more phrases to start tracking their Google rank.
addPhraseHint: Enter one keyword per line, or separate them with commas.

longTailResearch.title: Need more specific keyword ideas?
longTailResearch.description: Enter exactly one Google keyword of 80 characters or fewer. Keyword Research opens with the phrase and market prefilled, but it will not run a lookup automatically.

capReachedDescription: Your plan tracks up to {{cap}} keywords. Remove one or upgrade to add more.
suggestionsDescription: Find keywords worth tracking. We check your Search Console first, then keywords this site already ranks for, then relevant site ideas.
suggestionsLoadFailed: Could not find keywords for this site.
suggestionsFallbackCap: No new keywords were found, and your lookup allowance is exhausted before site ideas could be generated.
suggestionsGscSource: From your Search Console — real queries this site appeared for, ordered by impressions.
suggestionsBlendedSource: From your Search Console, blended with keywords this site ranks for and ideas from its pages. Each row shows its source.
suggestionsPartialCap: Showing what we found so far — your lookup allowance ran out before more ideas could be generated.
suggestionsPartialUnavailable: Showing what we found so far. Site-based ideas are temporarily unavailable; please try again later.
suggestionsRankedSource: Already ranking — ordered by estimated organic traffic.
suggestionsIdeaSource: Based on topics found across this site’s public pages.
suggestionsEmpty: No relevant keywords for this market were found in the site’s public content.
cadenceDailyDisabledTooltip: Daily tracking is part of paid add-ons.

dailyAddon.title: Unlock daily rank tracking
dailyAddon.description: Check your keyword rankings every day instead of weekly for {{price}}/month. Cancel anytime.
dailyAddon.checkoutFailed: Could not start checkout. Please try again.

trendSubtitle: How {{phrase}} has ranked over recent checks.
trendSelectPrompt: Select a keyword to view its trend.
trendNotEnoughData: First check runs Monday — trends appear after two checks.
trendChartLabel: Rank trend chart for {{phrase}}, {{count}} checks. Lower position is better.

errors.phraseTooLong: That keyword is too long (300 characters max).
errors.tooManyKeywords: You can add up to {{count}} more keywords.
errors.engineTargetRequired: Tell us which channel or product to follow on this engine.
errors.youtubeHandleInvalid: Enter a YouTube channel handle, for example @yourchannel.
errors.amazonAsinInvalid: Enter a ten-character Amazon ASIN, for example B08N5WRWNW.
errors.engineTargetNotAllowed: Google and Bing follow your own site, so leave this field empty.
errors.altEnginePreviewFailed: We could not check what this keyword costs. Try again.

serpFeatures.title: SERP features
serpFeatures.description: Which Google SERP features each tracked keyword showed on its last check. Captured from the rank checks you already run — no extra cost.
serpFeatures.noFeaturesObserved: No features observed on the last check
serpFeatures.ownedPaaCount: You answer {{count}} People Also Ask question(s)
serpFeatures.answerUnknown: Google did not show a source
serpFeatures.empty: Track a keyword to start recording the SERP features it shows.
serpFeatures.error: We could not load your SERP features.
serpFeatures.disabled: SERP feature tracking is temporarily unavailable. Your stored checks are safe.
serpFeatures.capturePaused: New SERP feature capture is paused. Your stored observations and history remain available.

engine.pickerHint: Google is included with every plan. Bing, YouTube, and Amazon are checked once a week and use a separate allowance.
engine.targetHintYoutube: We match this handle exactly against the channel on each result.
engine.targetHintAmazon: We match this ten-character code exactly against each product.
engine.previewUnit: One check per week uses one Bing, YouTube, and Amazon check.
engine.slotsExhausted: Every keyword slot on this plan is in use. Upgrade to add another.
engine.amazonProviderIndexNote: Position within the results our data provider returned, not a live shelf position.
